title: Ben Carpenter Joins Evercore as Senior Managing Director in the Healthcare Investment Banking Group
summary: Evercore announced today that Ben Carpenter has joined the firm as a senior managing director in the healthcare investment banking group, where he will focus on the biopharma sector. He will be based in San Francisco.
